arith_one.description: One arithmetic expression on a single number (double, square, half, add a constant, change the sign).

arith_two.description: One arithmetic expression on two numbers (difference, product, whole quotient, remainder, power).

arith_three.description: One arithmetic expression on three numbers or a short formula with named quantities (sum, product or average of three, price times count plus shipping).

compare.description: Comparisons of two or three numbers that return True or False (greater, equal, at most, between, all equal).

min_max_few.description: Smallest or largest of two or three numbers given as separate arguments, and one expression built on them.

parity_sign.description: True or False questions about one integer: even or odd, divisible by a number, positive or negative.

unit_conversion.description: Convert a quantity from one unit to another with a fixed formula (multiply, divide or integer-divide by a constant).

conditional_value.description: One if/else that chooses between two numbers (absolute value, never below zero, price by age, distance).

boolean_logic.description: Combine True/False arguments with and, or, not.

range_loops.description: Accumulate over the integers of a range: sums, products and counts of the numbers from 1 to n or from start to end.

list_build.description: Build a list from one or two numbers with range or repetition (1 to n, countdown, even numbers, copies of a value, squares).

list_aggregate.description: One number computed from all items of a list: sum, largest, smallest, mean, product, count of the items that pass a test on the single item, total length.

list_filter.description: Keep the items of a list that pass a test on the single item (even, negative, greater than a limit, not zero, short string).

list_map.description: Apply the same operation to every item of a list (double, square, add a constant, negate, length of each string).

list_index.description: Items at fixed positions of a list (first, last, middle, second) and one expression on them.

list_slice.description: A part of a list taken with one slice (first n, last n, without the first, without both ends, every second).

list_predicates.description: True or False questions about a list: contains a given item, is empty, is longer than n, all or any items pass a test on the single item.

list_edit.description: A new list made from a list by adding, removing or replacing one item at a fixed place (append, prepend, replace the first, remove at an index).

string_case_length.description: Upper and lower case of whole strings and lengths of strings.

string_predicates.description: True or False questions about one string (starts with, contains a space, only digits, is empty, first letter is upper case).

string_count.description: Count the characters of a string that equal a given character or are of a given kind (vowel, space, digit, upper case).

string_index_slice.description: Characters and parts of a string taken by index or by one slice.

string_build.description: Build a string from one or two given strings and fixed text, or by repeating a string.

reverse.description: Reverse the order of a whole list, of a whole string or of a few given values.

gcd_primes.description: Divisors of a number, smallest factor, greatest common divisor, least common multiple and prime numbers (a plain test whether one number divides another belongs to the near family parity_sign).

palindromes_anagrams.description: Palindromes and anagrams: a string, list or number that reads the same backwards, two strings made of the same characters.

classification.description: Return a word that names the class of one or two numbers, chosen with if tests (FizzBuzz-like, sign word, grade letter, even or odd word).

dict_ops.description: Dictionaries: count items into a dictionary, look up with a default, sum the values, find keys by value, invert.

sorting.description: Tasks solved by sorting (descending order, second largest, sort by length, is the list sorted, sorted letters).

nested_lists.description: Lists of lists and matrices (flatten, sum of every row, diagonal, largest entry, a column).

words.description: Split a text into words and join a list of words into a text (count words, first word, longest word, first letters, join with a separator).

running.description: Running totals and comparisons of neighbouring items of a list (running sum or product, differences, number of increases, largest step).

digits.description: Decimal digits of an integer (digit sum, number of digits, reversed digits, list of digits, tens digit).

searching.description: Find the position of an item or the first item that passes a test (index of an item, first negative number, position of the largest, last position).

duplicates.description: Repeated and distinct items of a list (has duplicates, number of repeats, number of distinct items, repeated items, all the same).

two_lists.description: Combine or compare two lists item by item (sums of pairs, dot product, common items, equal positions, alternate items).

sequences.description: Number sequences built step by step from earlier terms: Fibonacci numbers, Collatz steps, repeated doubling or halving up to a limit (sums and products over a range belong to the near family range_loops).

char_transform.description: Build a new string from a string one character at a time: remove, replace, repeat or keep selected characters.

rearrange.description: Move items inside a list: rotate, swap and shift (plain reversal belongs to the near family reverse).

binary.description: Binary numbers: convert between integers and strings of 0 and 1, count binary digits and one bits, flip bits.
